layers.authority: Local authorities, as reported by Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Smartraveller)
layers.process: Smartraveller says a visa is required for the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, which can be applied for on the Kurdistan Regional Government e-visa portal or obtained on arrival. It is valid in the Kurdistan Region only; travel to other regions of Iraq needs an Iraqi visa obtained before travelling.
